title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. translated_title: 在异构认知与生物医学知识图谱上对大型语言模型进行基准测试：图谱接地在多跳推理与幻觉缓解中的作用
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在生物医学和认知神经科学领域的应用日益广泛，但其在异构知识图谱（KG）上进行可靠推理的能力仍不明确。我们对五个大型语言模型（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen 和 BioGPT）在五个知识图谱上进行了基准测试：DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map 和 GDPKG。我们引入了一个多层次查询数据集，用于在知识图谱感知（图谱接地）和知识图谱无关两种条件下评估推理深度和事实准确性。标注者间一致性较高，Cohen's kappa 为 0.781（范围：0.753-0.807），Fleiss' kappa 为 0.77。结果表明，通用模型（尤其是 GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 2.0 Pro）在多跳和高级推理任务上通常优于领域专用模型，但随着查询复杂度的增加，性能会下降。图谱接地降低了所有被评估模型的幻觉率。与我们的初始假设相反……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究在五个认知与生物医学知识图谱上对五个大型语言模型进行基准测试，发现通用模型在多跳推理任务上优于领域专用模型，且知识图谱接地能有效降低所有模型的幻觉率。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks five LLMs across five cognitive and biomedical knowledge graphs, showing that general-purpose models outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop reasoning tasks, and that knowledge graph grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models.
